description: Get the headline money figures in one call: cash, what the company is owed (open invoices), what it owes (open bills), and net profit this month, the EXACT numbers on the user's Home dashboard. Use for "how am I doing", "how much am I owed", "what do I owe", "what's my position", a quick business health check, or any quick headline-figure question. For how a past month went, use get_profit_and_loss for that month. For invoice/bill line-level detail use get_invoices/get_bills; for ageing use get_aged_debtors/get_aged_creditors.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

name: get_financial_snapshot
title: Get Financial Snapshot
